unit_tests.scope: Related pvisor-vm tests in the existing minimal-dependency Linux/KVM validation workspace, overlaid with submitted Rust files. Not a full-workspace build or a replay.
unit_tests.command: cargo nextest run --locked --offline -p pvisor-vm --lib -E "test(shared_backing) or test(guest_idle) or test(pending_control_survives) or test(control_ack_)"

formatting: rustfmt edition 2024 on changed Rust files; git diff --check passed
data_check: All three result sets contain the same four task IDs, four trajectories per task, and identical official outcomes.
